svg.title: Plan precedents: a floor plan in, the five closest homes out of 5,000
svg.desc: Plan 1191 comes in. On the map of the 5,000 CubiCasa5K plans, as the v3 network arranges them, the plans light up from the closest to the farthest. Rings mark the five matches and your plan sits at their middle. Then the five closest homes appear with their distances: 18.0, 106.4, 108.3, 123.0, 123.3; the median plan is at 234.0.

text.tspan: Real data: the v3 network and plan 1191.
Darker dots are closer to it;
